title: REMOVAL OF CYLINDER

BR-34

BRAKE SYSTEM — Rear Brake

REMOVAL OF CYLINDER
(See page BR-31)

1. DISCONNECT BRAKE LINE
Disconnect the brake hose. Use a container to catch the brake fluid.

2. REMOVE CYLINDER FROM TORQUE PLATE
Remove the installation bolt and cylinder.

3. REMOVE PADS
(See step 4 on page BR-32)
